contract.loss: plain endpoint cross-entropy for all T1/T2/T3 horizons
contract.feedback: soft marginals in train and evaluation

hypothesis: Exact sum-product inference over a conditional latent-state chain can give dense endpoint credit to all compatible latent paths and learn one reusable transition across all supervised horizons.
correction_history: Before submission, inactive transitions were indexed by destination place, N width became the output width, current-X presence updated after each macrostep, exact state drift was asserted, and parser/matrix operations were vectorized. The fixed WFST mechanism did not change.
conclusion: Dense all-horizon sum-product training retained weak OOD signal but produced only 2/512 on both T1 profiles. It missed both strict thresholds.
limitation: One Easy E5 seed and one exact latent-chain contract; this stops CL-WFST-32, not all probabilistic latent models.
no_retry_history: Do not retry latent states, rank, feedback, horizon policy, learning rate, batch, or seed. Advance to a fast-weight delta-rule mechanism.
